SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Pronunciation and vocabulary, part of Technology Suggested vocabulary mobile phone, tablet, charge, charger, power, ba in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why should we pronounce words correctly? 2. Why should we understand the meaning of words used in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen attentively and pick out words with the target letter- sound combinations from audio- visual clips, - ‘gr’ as grass, green - ‘pr’ as in print, press - / ɔɪ / as in oil, point - / uː/ as in pool, spoon - / ʊ/ as in put. 1.
